en: The image shows a monochrome view of a landscaped park area featuring a tall obelisk monument standing on a plinth. The obelisk is flanked by two statues of winged female figures holding musical instruments, likely representing Muses or angels. There are broad steps leading up to the monument, which is bordered by trees and a chain fence. Two people with an umbrella are visible near the monument, adding a sense of scale. The upper edge of the image appears damaged or faded, and faint text seems partially legible in the upper left corner.
